title: Making Good the Equipment and Extras Laid On for a Snowsports School Participant
content:
The school also makes good the equipment and extras it had laid on for the participant, by the number of add-on entries standing against the Snowsports School booking.

Where two or more add-on entries stand against the booking, the product's rental add-on price is added. Where exactly one add-on entry stands against it, the single add-on make-good of 45.00 USD is added. Where no add-on entry stands against it, nothing is added, the amount standing at 0.00 USD.

## The rental add-on prices the first band reads

| Product | Rental add-on price (USD) |
| --- | --- |
| All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson | 59.00 |
| Mountain Explorers Group Lesson | 0.00 |
| Mountain Cubs Group Lesson | 0.00 |
| Six-Week Development Programme | 49.00 |
| Semi-Private Coaching Session | 59.00 |
| Private Instruction Full Day | 79.00 |
| Elite Performance Camp | 89.00 |

## The three bands set out

| Add-on entries standing against the booking | Amount added |
| --- | --- |
| 2 or more | the product's rental add-on price |
| exactly 1 | 45.00 USD |
| none | 0.00 USD |

The entries counted are the add-on entries standing on that booking's school account as they stand on the handling date, whatever kind of add-on each of them is for.

## Both sides of the bands, on hypothetical figures

- A booking of the Private Instruction Full Day against which 3 add-on entries stand falls in the first band, and 79.00 USD is added.
- The same booking with exactly 2 add-on entries standing is still in the first band, and 79.00 USD is added.
- The same booking with exactly 1 add-on entry standing falls in the second band, and 45.00 USD is added, whatever that product's rental add-on price may be.
- The same booking with no add-on entry standing falls in the third band, and nothing is added.
- A booking of the Mountain Explorers Group Lesson against which 2 add-on entries stand falls in the first band, and that product's rental add-on price of 0.00 USD is added, so the amount added comes to nothing.
